scenes.text: Quiz time! 6 tricky questions, from episodes 1 to 10. [1] Five seconds each. Count how many you get right. [2] Ready? Let's go!
Question 1. Which one of these is NOT generative AI? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] A spam filter! It sorts emails into spam or not spam. It doesn't create anything new.

data.question: Which one is NOT generative AI?

scenes.text: Question 2. Roughly how many words fit in one thousand tokens? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] About 750 words, because one token is roughly three quarters of a word.
Question 3. At its core, what is a large language model trained to do? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] Predict the next token! Everything else is built on top of that one skill.

Question 4. In embedding space, which word sits closest to puppy? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] Dog! Embeddings group words by meaning, not by spelling, so puppet and pupil are far away.

Question 5. Your bot must answer from today's price list, which changes daily. What's the best approach? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] RAG! Look up the latest prices at answer time. A fine-tuned model would already be out of date.

Question 6. In function calling, who actually runs the weather API? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] Your app's code! The model only asks for the tool. Your app runs it, and sends back the result.
So, how many did you get? [1] 6 out of 6? You're a true AI Maastaaru! [2] 4 or 5, great work. [3] 3 or less? Rewatch episodes 1 to 10, and try again. [4] Comment your score below!
